import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    chars = list(s)
    boundaries = []
    for i in range(1, len(chars)):
        if chars[i] != chars[i-1]:
            boundaries.append(i)
    boundaries.append(len(chars))
    count = 0
    start = 0
    for end in boundaries:
        if ((end - start) & 1) == 0:
            count += 1
        start = end
    print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
